method: Pearson product-moment correlation across the 32 clubs, computed from the official standings and official team-stats tables only. Two-sided p-value from the t-distribution with n-2 degrees of freedom. Pairs are published when |r| >= 0.40 or when either side is points for, points against, net points, wins or win percentage.
caveat: n = 32 team-seasons to date. These are team-level associations, not game-level correlations, and they say nothing about causation. They are not the same quantity as the same-game correlation a parlay price needs.
